description: Deep structural equality of two values. The engine compares the actual value against the expected value by structure, not by reference: two objects with the same keys and values are equal regardless of key order, and arrays are equal only when every corresponding element is equal. The positive relation reports a violation (with a diagnostic naming both rendered operands) when the values are not structurally equal; the negated relation reports a violation when they ARE equal. When the relation is satisfied the engine reports that the assertion held with no diagnostic.
